bio: Eat, drink, make merry, meet friends… the Kreis 4 district is to Zurich what the Barranco district is to Lima. Nestled among a host of other restaurants and bars, the Peruvian neighbourhood's namesake serves modern Peruvian cuisine that is bursting with flavour, zing and spices. The dishes are designed to be shared and tasted together. The atmosphere is pleasingly unpretentious in this inviting space with a trendy decor featuring Peruvian murals – the relaxed yet efficient service is the icing on the cake. Great cocktail selection. There is a terrace in front of the building, separated from the pavement by plants....
